dependency_rules.no_hardcoded_colors: All colors must reference CSS variables defined in DESIGN.md, no hardcoded hex values are allowed.
dependency_rules.no_border_radius: Zero border-radius is enforced everywhere on cards, buttons, and images (always sharp corners).
dependency_rules.no_box_shadows: Box shadows are forbidden on all cards, buttons, and other UI elements.
dependency_rules.no_unused_fonts: Only Cormorant Garamond, Jost, and Noto Serif Devanagari fonts are allowed.
dependency_rules.sanskrit_labels: Sanskrit labels in Noto Serif Devanagari must precede or sit above all service titles.
dependency_rules.animation_properties: Animations must use only opacity and transform properties to ensure smooth performance.
dependency_rules.reduced_motion: All animations must respect users' prefers-reduced-motion media query settings.
dependency_rules.no_desktop_video_mobile: On mobile devices, hero background videos must be replaced with static poster fallback images.
dependency_rules.sanity_client_only: All data fetching for dynamic content must go through the Sanity client and utilize static generation.
dependency_rules.secure_form: Contact forms must use Web3Forms with honeypot spam protection.
dependency_rules.seo_optimizations: All pages must export appropriate metadata and include schema.org EventPlanner structured data.
